title: JoiningActions
description: Gives players the most basic effect of entering the server
body:
# JoiningActions
Tips: This is the first plugin I've written, just something I made while learning, so if the pros have any suggestions, I'd love to hear them. 
The plugin is really simple, it just plays a sound effect when a player joins the server and shows a welcome message in the chat (I can't modify it yet because I haven't finished learning awa).
